Claude also gets sandbox_run, sandbox_jobs, sandbox_result and sandbox_apply. Each job starts from the project as it is now (tracked files, credentials left out) in its own worktree, every result is marked remote, and a job's changes reach your disk only as a patch you apply after a question. /jev-vercel-sandbox starts it and opens a side pane with the jobs. Falls back to the engine's built-in classifier without a Jev key. Needs function hooks (early access).

mods.description: Shows the background shell tasks of the session on the status line or in the shared sidebar, with the oldest one's age, and stops one from the /bg-tasks pane.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: bughunt
mods.description: Runs proof-driven bug hunt rounds with /bughunt: each round proves one bug with a failing command the mod runs itself, fixes it, and proves the fix, and the loop stops on a blocked or unverified round. /bughunt collab runs a read-only scanner, planner and critic in sequence.

mods.name: cache-warm
mods.description: Keeps the 1-hour prompt cache warm for a window you set, or with no end in every session under always, with one cache-shared fork per idle stretch and one keep-warm message after a resume, arms a window for you after a paid cold write, and shows the cache state, the cold price and this session's cold writes.

mods.name: config-parse
mods.description: Parses each JSON, YAML, TOML or .env file an Edit or Write touches, notes a parse error at once instead of at the next build, and says so again when a later edit fixes it.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: context-restore
mods.description: Hands a skill or command call the current text of its file when the file changed on disk after the session loaded it, and hands the model a rules file or the global CLAUDE.md that changed on disk.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: contract-watch
mods.description: After the model changes a function signature with Edit, adds the callers ripwire finds to the Edit's result, so the model fixes them before the build does.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: council
mods.description: Asks a council of models about a hard problem, when the model calls its tool or you run /council <question>: Claude models, and Gemini models when gemini-core has a key, answer in parallel, and the model of the session writes one verdict from their answers.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: dep-sentinel
mods.description: Checks each package the model installs against its registry and OSV.dev, and stops a missing, brand-new, look-alike, outdated or vulnerable one, naming the latest version.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: desk-notify
mods.description: Sends a desktop notification when a question or a plan waits for your answer, and when a turn ends or fails.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: diagram-render
mods.description: Renders the mermaid blocks of the model's replies with an installed mmdc after each turn and draws each picture under its reply.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: disk-janitor
mods.description: Measures the build artifacts of the repository, shows them on the status line from 5 GB, and deletes the ones you pick in the /disk-janitor pane; data directories are never listed.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: edit-loop

mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: env-sync
mods.description: After each commit the model makes, names the env variables its added lines read that .env.example lacks, with the file and line of each.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: error-poke
mods.description: Sends one continue prompt after a turn an API error killed, so the half-done work carries on instead of the session going idle, at most 99 times in a row by default.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: flaky-memory
mods.description: Remembers which tests failed on which code, and tells the model when a failing test has both passed and failed on the same code, so it runs the test again instead of changing code.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: gemini-advisor
mods.description: Gives the model a Gemini advisor tool it calls by itself: Gemini reads the whole conversation and the model's message and answers with a second opinion. Off until /gemini-advisor on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: gemini-compact
mods.description: Moves compaction from Claude to Gemini: in summary mode Gemini summarizes the conversation and the newest messages stay verbatim, in prune mode every message stays and Gemini keeps, cuts or drops older tool calls. Off until /gemini-compact on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: gemini-core
mods.description: Keeps the Gemini keys and tier of every Gemini mod, and each mod's model and thinking level, in one place: adds $.gemini, which builds their Gemini requests, reads the answers and moves to the next key after a quota or key error, and picks a model from Google's list.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: gemini-plan-review
mods.description: Has Gemini review each plan before the approval dialog, from the plan and the conversation, and sends a plan with a blocking finding back to the model, at most twice. Off until /gemini-plan-review on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: gemini-review
mods.description: Has Gemini review every git commit the model runs, from the staged diff and the conversation, and stops a commit with a blocking finding: a bug, data loss, a security hole or a committed secret. Off until /gemini-review on; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: git-commit
mods.description: Ships a commit skill and holds every Bash git commit to it: a commit the skill did not open, a blanket git add, a signature trailer, a secret, an ignored path, or a push or branch change nobody asked for is stopped before git runs.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: i18n-watch
mods.description: After an edit that calls translation keys, names the keys the JSON, Laravel PHP, YAML or gettext locale files lack, and the languages that lack them.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: idle-art
mods.description: Draws an ASCII animation above the prompt while the model works: matrix rain, fire, an aquarium, a cat, or a GIF of your own imported as a character clip for every project. Display only: nothing reaches the model.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: limit-watch

mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.description: Lists the servers a Bash call of the model started in this repository and left listening on a port, with their age and session, and stops one with SIGTERM, then SIGKILL.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: output-flood
mods.description: Measures how much context each Bash command spent and tells the model, past a size limit, which narrower command would have answered the same question.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: pin-note
mods.description: Keeps the notes you pin with /pin-note for the whole session and sends them to the model again, word for word, after each compaction and /clear. Off until /pin-note on.

mods.name: probe-runner

mods.name: prompt-deck

mods.name: prompt-offload
mods.description: Writes a prompt longer than the limit (2000 characters by default) to a temp file and sends the model its first 200 characters with the path, so one paste does not fill the context.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: prompt-time
mods.description: Draws the time under each of your messages and each text block of the model's replies, also for a resumed session whose transcript is 4 MiB or smaller. Display only: nothing reaches the model.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: sage-memory

mods.name: self-command

mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: session-watch
mods.description: Shows this session's state in the sidebar: context fill, token totals, cost, model and effort, the Claude Code version, the other sessions of this machine, and the git branch and status.
mods.author: Kerem Gok

mods.name: shot-inline
mods.description: Draws each PNG or JPG the model saves or reads under its tool row: pixels in kitty and Ghostty, quadrant block cells in every other terminal.

mods.description: Shows a live session pane (/ctx): context breakdown, usage limits with pace, tool calls and model requests; sends the model a one-time note when limits or context cross a threshold

mods.author: Mehmet Aras

mods.name: turn-timeline
mods.description: Draws the current turn as a timeline in a pane (/timeline): model requests and tool calls per loop, where the time went, and the slowest steps

mods.name: quota-meter

mods.name: token-ledger

mods.name: mod
mods.description: 5dive telemetry producer, seat panel, command surface and tool-call policy guard for Claude Code function hooks (early access). Publishes turn and session boundaries and the account's usage reading from inside the harness process to a per-seat JSONL sink, so the heartbeat, the pacing floor and the self-update's pending-restart sweep can read a first-class signal instead of inferring idle/busy from pane samples and the task board. Registers /task and /gate, which dispatch to the 5dive CLI in-process. It also draws one line above the prompt naming the row the seat holds, its gate, its grader and its token burn against its budget, at zero context cost. On the NON-FRESH seats it can additionally compact the conversation at a turn boundary, so the next dispatched goal lands on a summary instead of the whole accumulated window; that half pins any unanswered human gate or standing directive back into the compacted transcript. And it enforces a table-driven deny list over tool calls (policy/guard.json), so a rule that today costs every seat tokens on every turn and is caught after the fact is refused before the tool runs, with the reason handed to the model. Every capability is off unless the seat opts in; the compact hook is the only one that rewrites a call and the guard is the only one that can refuse one.
mods.author: 5dive

mods.description: Toolbox for Claude Code's Workflow tool: author deterministic multi-agent workflow scripts (workflow-composer, with the @workflow-toolbox compile-time pattern toolkit as its standard library), scaffold a build-clean workflow skeleton from a spec (toolkit-scaffold), diagnose a failed run from its journal and decide whether resumeFromRunId helps (workflow-debugger), re-verify the runtime surface after a Claude Code upgrade (upgrade-canary), run a bias-free multi-lens analysis of any subject when relevant (independent-analysis), and run a deep-grounding pass that collects and verifies evidence against the real sources before asserting or analyzing (deep-grounding), and install, check, and migrate editable, versioned copies of the plugin's own rules and agent definitions into a project's or user's config directory (adopt). Ships the independent-analysis workflow that skill triggers (domain-agnostic adversarial multi-lens analysis), a Stop hook that auto-surfaces a finished Workflow run's cost + traceability audit report (always a notice; grabs the session when the run looks like trouble, was degraded by a silently-denied tool call, or requested external delegation whose agents show no real external-CLI invocation), and a tracker-agnostic actionability Stop gate that blocks only while startable work remains with nothing running, paired with a Planka producer that writes the snapshot it reads automatically from board-reading tool calls (never a guess: it writes nothing from a partial read or a read without card descriptions, uses the project's own dependency parser when one exists and the shipped one otherwise, and never counts a card without a Depends-on line as startable). Also ships the pilot agent suite (pilot / pilot-orchestrator / pilot-watchdog) and the pilot-wave composer skill for driving tracked task-tracker cards by delegation, plus a conditional SessionStart hook that injects a generic delegation ladder where a project does tracked/delegated work and points at the delegation-chain skill (a non-user-invocable reference on spawn shapes, the upward report chain, wake signals, and what each shipped watcher/guard does and does not cover) before a delegation decision is made. Ships two Planka kanban skills for any project that wants board-based task tracking: planka-tracking (onboard a project: create the board, migrate an existing progress.md into cards, write the pointer) and what-next (propose the logical next step from that board, or from progress.md/conversation when there's no board), both requiring only a reachable planka MCP server.

Under claude-md-or-agents-md a project with no instruction files of its own gets its AGENTS.md files instead: a prompt.context hook asks $.fs.ancestors for every AGENTS.md and .claude/AGENTS.md from the filesystem root down to the working directory and hands them to the engine as project instruction files, which it renders, announces and withholds from agents exactly as it does CLAUDE.md, skipping any file the engine already loaded by import or link; a tool.call hook on Read attaches the ones under the project root as the engine attaches a nested CLAUDE.md. Under claude-md-and-agents-md every AGENTS.md is loaded beside CLAUDE.md. Under managed-only the project's and the person's instruction files are dropped and the organization's managed ones kept. mods.description: Replaces context compaction in the controller's interactive session of a log-driven repo: the conversation is rebuilt from .context/events.jsonl by `eventlog context`, plus the last few turns word for word. Rebuilds at the log's task boundaries and at a fill backstop; /rebuild queues a rebuild for the end of the next turn, and /compact rebuilds from the log at once. Inert in headless sessions, for other EVENTLOG_AS writers, with EVENTLOG_CONTEXT=off, and in a repo without the log. Falls back to the engine's compaction when eventlog fails.
mods.author: radiator-engineering

mods.name: offcut
mods.description: Cleans up finished git worktrees as soon as a turn or a session ends. When a turn ends (the main session's or a subagent's), it runs `offcut apply --only auto --yes` for the session's repo in the background: a worktree goes only if it is clean, pushed, and its work is merged or eventlog says its agent is done. When the session ends, it runs once more a few seconds later, also clearing unused build caches, so the session's own worktree can go. Every removal is recorded for `offcut restore`. Inert when `offcut` is not installed, outside a git repo, or with OFFCUT=off.

mods.description: Claude as a small coworker in the terminal: an orange pixel-art Claude, two rows tall, in 132 frames. While a turn runs he sits beside the spinner in a scene for every spinner word (a thought bubble, a pen on a notepad, a book, a magnifying glass over text or over a globe, a laptop, a terminal, his own small helpers, a gear, a scroll for a skill, a plug for an MCP call); idle on the status row he breathes, blinks, strolls, yawns and sips a coffee, sweats near a full context and sleeps frosted once the prompt cache goes cold.
